scope: Existing-only/borrowed recovery refuses row evidence above1MiB and cumulative scalar preflight charges above8MiB before SQLite returns raw text or BLOB to JS.
Scalar queries return at most129 rows;128 is the accepted inventory cap. Queue/intake reads are rechecked before each cancellation to catch trigger changes.
Related original ingress rows and all active unowned target rows are bounded before decoding or JSON filtering. No truncation or partial cancellation.

Repeated checks consume budget again. Oversized or too many non-prompt active target rows can conservatively refuse recovery. This is an explicitly stricter bounded refusal, not exact Rust acceptance parity.
Initialized compatibility API keeps previous behavior.
